vo.text: A push is four phases, not one. Knowing them tells you what a slow run is waiting for.
vo.next_text: Nothing is read before the push begins. Stations are written in sequence with a short pause between each, and the progress line names which one it is on.

vo.text: Nothing is read before the push begins. Stations are written in sequence with a short pause between each, and the progress line names which one it is on.
vo.previous_text: A push is four phases, not one. Knowing them tells you what a slow run is waiting for.
vo.next_text: The writing counter runs on a fixed timer and does not wait for Lynx. If a run stalls, it stalls in the next phase, while Spatial Adjust waits for Lynx to answer.

vo.text: The writing counter runs on a fixed timer and does not wait for Lynx. If a run stalls, it stalls in the next phase, while Spatial Adjust waits for Lynx to answer.
vo.previous_text: Nothing is read before the push begins. Stations are written in sequence with a short pause between each, and the progress line names which one it is on.
vo.next_text: With the writing done, Spatial Adjust retrieves the current percent adjustments from Lynx.

vo.previous_text: The writing counter runs on a fixed timer and does not wait for Lynx. If a run stalls, it stalls in the next phase, while Spatial Adjust waits for Lynx to answer.
vo.next_text: This is a read-back, not a baseline. It is collecting what Lynx actually holds now, so the next phase has something to check the push against.

vo.text: This is a read-back, not a baseline. It is collecting what Lynx actually holds now, so the next phase has something to check the push against.
vo.previous_text: With the writing done, Spatial Adjust retrieves the current percent adjustments from Lynx.
vo.next_text: Spatial Adjust re-reads the station list and compares each value it sent against what Lynx now reports.

vo.next_text: Anything that does not match is treated as failed rather than assumed good.

vo.next_text: Stations that did not take are re-pushed, up to two further attempts after the first. The progress line names how many are being retried, so a retry is information rather than an error.
